answer: Beacon spot-checks plus compute heartbeats stop bulk fake identities. Each agent deposits 50 credits into a locked vault, then must answer a random beacon challenge and send a live compute pulse hourly. Missing two pulses forfeits the bond and drops the agent one terrace level, losing work slots. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 credits plus compute per fake pulse, while honest agents pay once, keep their bond, and earn undiluted rewards.
